### Staying Encouraged When We Face Opposition - The Crosswalk Devotional - September 29
Author: Laura Bailey  
Site: Crosswalk.com  
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/staying-encouraged-when-we-face-opposition-the-crosswalk-devotional.html  
Passage: Ezra 4:4  
Points:
- Believers should expect opposition, hindrances, and discouragement when pursuing God's work.
- Closed doors or pushback from others do not mean God has abandoned His calling.
- Christians do not need human validation because God's approval is already sufficient.
- Faced with intimidation, believers must choose perseverance over fear and weariness.
- God's sovereign plans cannot be thwarted, and He will sustain His people to accomplish His will.
